# Data Source: catalyst_job_pool

Read an existing Job Scheduling pool by ID. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.jobpool.READ`. Capacity fields are null when Catalyst omits them. This read uses the official lookup contract and has offline verification.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_job_pool" "selected" {
  project_id = "123456789"
  id         = "987654321"
}

output "job_pool_capacity" {
  value = {
    memory_mb = data.catalyst_job_pool.selected.capacity_memory_mb
    count     = data.catalyst_job_pool.selected.capacity_count
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing job pool's positive numeric ID as a string.
- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `capacity_count` (Number) Configured target count when available.
- `capacity_memory_mb` (Number) Configured pool memory in MB when available.
- `name` (String) Current job pool name.
- `type` (String) Job pool target type reported by Catalyst.
